methodology.notes: Agent served on Fireworks AI (accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v4-flash-0731), temperature 0.0, no max_tokens override; user simulator gpt-5.2 at temperature 0.0. Identical agent/user configuration across all four domains. Cost is agent-side cost per conversation as computed by tau2 from LiteLLM token accounting, using Fireworks list pricing registered locally via litellm.register_model ($0.14/M input, $0.028/M cached input, $0.28/M output); this affects reported cost only, not prompts, tools or model behaviour. banking_knowledge used retrieval_config=alltools. Disclosure on banking_knowledge trial coverage: all 97 tasks were run with 4 trials and no task filtering; 96 tasks have 4 scored trials and task_092 has 3. One trial of task_092 repeatedly returned a response with no content and no tool calls (completion_tokens pinned at the 32768 output cap), which tau2 classifies as INFRASTRUCTURE_ERROR and excludes from metrics; it did not clear after ~28 retries. pass_4 is therefore reported as null for banking_knowledge, while pass_1 through pass_3 cover all 97 tasks. airline, retail and telecom are complete: 4 scored trials on every task with zero infrastructure errors.
